videos.title: 580 - Business has no game over screen
videos.description:
580 - Basketball ends and somebody gets called the winner. Business never gets that buzzer. There is no season where you play for three years and then walk off because the game is over.

#business #strategy #ai #competition

videos.title: 580 - Wait for perfect data and you never ship
videos.description:
580 - Waiting for perfect data means you never start. The data is alive. Today the customers sit in Dynamics, and a strategy shift can move them to Salesforce before the cleanup is done.

#dataquality #dynamics #salesforce #analytics

videos.title: 580 - Has your company data ever been perfect?
videos.description:
580 - Has any company you've worked with ever had data that was 100% ready? In Power BI that target has always moved, because the business keeps changing. So how does data ever get ready for AI?

#dataquality #powerbi #ai #analytics

videos.title: 580 - AI-ready data is just good data
videos.description:
580 - James's definition of AI-ready data is accurate and full of business context, the kind of thing a model can interpret. Pull the new label off. It's the same standard we've talked about for 10 years.

#aiready #dataquality #analytics #datagovernance

videos.title: 580 - The new warehouse deployed with no data
videos.description:
580 - The new warehouse deployed. There's no data in it. Production can't be touched, and a full 10-year copy is overkill, so the real question is how much of a slice dev and QA actually need.

#datawarehouse #testdata #devops #dataengineering

videos.title: 580 - New Delta features stay private for months
videos.description:
580 - New Delta tricks stay inside Databricks for six to nine months before they hit the open spec. That window is the edge. Power BI and every other reader of those tables just waits.

#databricks #deltalake #powerbi #dataengineering

videos.title: 580 - Once data lands, companies won't move it
videos.description:
580 - Once an organization lands its data, it almost never wants to move it again. A big Databricks estate with tons of tables stays put. The win shows up when the environment is still new.

#databricks #datagravity #dataengineering #migration

videos.title: 580 - Wireframes now live inside the report
videos.description:
580 - Planning visuals got easier, so the wireframes are moving into the Power BI report. Extra pages on real data let the agent read the intent while the layout is still rough.

#powerbi #wireframes #aiagents #reportdesign

videos.title: 580 - The agent screenshots its own Power BI page
videos.description:
580 - A preview server inside Power BI Desktop lets the agent see the live report. After each edit it reloads and screenshots the page so it can judge its own rendering.

#powerbi #aiagents #claude #reportbuilding

videos.title: 580 - 30 minutes of talking wrote the spec
videos.description:
580 - Thirty minutes of talking to a bot turned a rough app idea into a product requirements doc. The best part was asking it to grill the gaps until the weak spots had names.

#productspec #voiceai #agents #buildinginpublic

videos.title: 580 - You now have to brief the AI clearly
videos.description:
580 - Words got heavier once the AI had to build from them. You still need to read a room with clients. Now you also have to say the vision so precisely a model can make it.

#prompting #communication #ai #softskills

videos.title: 580 - I didn't write a lick of code
videos.description:
580 - Skill Vault is in a client's hands, and they already want the next feature. I didn't write a lick of code. What shipped was the picture in my head, followed all the way through.

#skillvault #nocode #aiagents #sideprojects

videos.title: 580 - Context switching all day wears me out
videos.description:
580 - By the end of the day the brain is cooked from jumping between projects and bots. It can feel productive right up until you realize one thing never got enough attention.

#contextswitching #aifatigue #productivity #agents

videos.title: 580 - We're losing something by skipping grunt work
videos.description:
580 - Most of the day is questions about what the report should show. Decimal places and broken numbers barely show up anymore. There's still this nagging sense that skipping the grunt work costs something.

#gruntwork #analytics #ai #datawork
